purpose: Define non-punitive, trauma-informed, civilian-centered protocols for municipal safety interventions.

trauma_informed_engagement.description: Protocols ensuring all municipal interactions minimize psychological harm and prevent escalation.

protocols.name: Calm-Approach Protocol
protocols.action: Approach civilians slowly, non-aggressively, with open posture and non-threatening tone.

protocols.name: Emotional-State Assessment
protocols.action: Identify signs of distress, fear, trauma triggers, or escalation risk.

protocols.name: Consent-Based Interaction
protocols.action: Seek voluntary cooperation whenever possible; avoid coercive commands.

de_escalation_protocols.description: Structured techniques to reduce tension, stabilize situations, and prevent harm.

protocols.name: Verbal De-Escalation
protocols.action: Use calm, slow, respectful communication to reduce emotional intensity.

protocols.name: Environmental Stabilization
protocols.action: Reduce noise, crowding, and sensory overload to prevent escalation.

protocols.name: Time & Space Buffer
protocols.action: Allow physical distance and time for emotional regulation.

civilian_stabilization.description: Protocols to ensure immediate safety, grounding, and emotional stabilization.

protocols.name: Grounding Technique Deployment
protocols.action: Guide civilians through grounding exercises to reduce panic or dissociation.

protocols.name: Safety Needs Assessment
protocols.action: Identify immediate physical, emotional, or environmental safety needs.

protocols.name: Support Resource Linkage
protocols.action: Connect civilians to mental health, shelter, food, or crisis resources.

harm_reduction.description: Protocols that reduce risk without punitive or force-based measures.

protocols.name: Risk Minimization Strategy
protocols.action: Identify least-harm pathways for resolving the situation.

protocols.name: Non-Coercive Safety Planning
protocols.action: Develop voluntary safety plans with civilians.

protocols.name: Force Avoidance Mandate
protocols.action: Prohibit force unless life-threatening conditions exist.

vulnerable_population_protection.description: Specialized protocols for youth, elderly, disabled, and marginalized individuals.

protocols.name: Youth-Safe Engagement
protocols.action: Use age-appropriate communication and trauma-aware techniques.

protocols.name: Disability-Accommodation Protocol
protocols.action: Ensure accessibility, communication support, and sensory accommodations.

protocols.name: Marginalized-Group Safeguards
protocols.action: Apply enhanced protections for groups historically harmed by municipal systems.

kernel_dependencies.identity_kernel: Required for actor verification and accommodation logic.
kernel_dependencies.telemetry_kernel: Required for risk detection and emotional-state analysis.
